site.name: freew.org
site.description: A list of apps and repositories that states the terms of each. Some are free software. The catalog lists Air Traffic Control (ATC), Amber Phosphor, COBOL, CTMU, Gas Plasma, iB-theme, NovaCEE Offline, P1PW, Pascal, RockyBack, VB.NET, and WordPerfect Blue. Air Traffic Control (ATC), COBOL, NovaCEE Offline, Pascal, RockyBack, and VB.NET are proprietary, and their published licenses grant no permission to use them.

work.name: Air Traffic Control (ATC)
work.summary: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, OpenCode, Pi, JetBrains Junie, and Grok from Nova, each flight in its own Git worktree, with diff review, races, hand-offs, and merge or pull request.

work.name: Amber Phosphor
work.summary: Amber phosphor terminal theme for Apple Terminal and iTerm2. PC-12 phosphor #FFB000 on #1A1000.

work.name: COBOL
work.summary: COBOL support for Nova in fixed and free format, with GnuCOBOL build, run, debugging, and diagnostics.

work.name: CTMU
work.summary: A command-line tool for macOS. QR codes, hashing, networking, files, images, text, and system tasks.

work.name: Gas Plasma
work.summary: Orange-dominant dark theme. Foreground #FF8C00 on background #1A0A00.

work.name: iB-theme
work.summary: IBM Carbon theme with dark and light variants. Dark foreground #ffffff on #161616. Light foreground #161616 on #ffffff.

work.name: NovaCEE Offline
work.summary: Searches Dash-format docsets in Nova without a network connection, installs docsets, a search index, and toolchains only after their SHA-256 hashes match a manifest, and runs those toolchains, with Library Health and Disk Usage.

work.name: P1PW
work.summary: Warm, paper-toned light theme for Apple Terminal. Foreground #1A1A1A on background #F5F5F0.

work.name: Pascal
work.summary: Pascal and Object Pascal support for Nova, with Free Pascal build, run, and diagnostics.

work.name: RockyBack
work.summary: Prepares a Rocky Linux 9 or AlmaLinux 9 VPS and installs a verified ClambBack release.

work.name: VB.NET
work.summary: Visual Basic .NET support for Nova, with .NET SDK build, run, test, publish, and diagnostics.

work.name: WordPerfect Blue
work.summary: WordPerfect 5.1 white-on-blue theme for Apple Terminal. Foreground #FFFFFF on background #00007B.
